title: Synthetic Supernova Light Curves Dataset with 7 parameters

citation.text: Luca Naso. (2025). Synthetic Supernova Light Curves Dataset (Version 1.0.0). Koexai Srl.

abstract: This dataset contains approximately 10,000 synthetic light curves generated using semi-analytical models for supernova research. Each light curve consists of 1,601 uniformly distributed temporal samples over 400 days with a 6-hour cadence. The dataset includes corresponding physical parameters for each simulated supernova: progenitor radius, mass and energy, nickel percentage, circumstellar medium radius and mass, and slope parameter. The synthetic data is designed to support machine learning applications in supernova classification and parameter estimation studies.
purpose: Supporting machine learning research in supernova classification and physical parameter estimation

provenance.processing: Uniform temporal sampling at 6-hour intervals over 400-day period
provenance.derivations: Seven physical parameters derived from progenitor and circumstellar medium models

structure.conventions: Time in days from explosion start; flux values in arbitrary units; missing values coded as NaN
structure.relationships: light_curves.parquet and params.parquet linked by implicit row index

quality.validation: Model consistency checks applied; parameter ranges validated against physical constraints
limitations: Semi-analytical models may not capture all physical complexity
Parameter space limited to specific progenitor and CSM configurations
No observational noise included in synthetic data
quality.usageGuidance: Suitable for algorithm development and testing; not recommended for direct comparison with observational data without noise modeling
